sourceDocument: Gazette Extraordinary No. 2481/22, Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (27 March 2026)
note: The Commissioner General may amend this format from time to time. Re-verify this file against the primary gazette text before relying on it for a real filing, and check for newer gazette notifications periodically.

fields.label: Invoice Title
fields.format: Must prominently display the text 'TAX INVOICE' in bold or highlighted text.

fields.label: Purchaser TIN
fields.format: 9-digit TIN, required where the purchaser is VAT-registered (needed for their input VAT claim).

fields.label: Purchaser Name
fields.format: Full name of the purchasing business or individual.

fields.label: Invoice Serial Number
fields.format: Exact structure YYMMM_QQQQ_XXXXX — YY: last 2 digits of the year. MMM: first 3 uppercase letters of the month (e.g. JUL). QQQQ: 1-15 character alphanumeric code identifying branch/section/unit/project/customer/classification. XXXXX: purely numeric sequential serial number. Maximum 40 characters total, no spaces.
fields.implementationNote: The gazette's own worked example ('26JULBR03-1') does not strictly follow this stated structure (no underscores, no zero-padding). Validate against the stated rule, not the example, and flag this discrepancy to the user if their format matches neither cleanly.

fields.label: Goods/Services Description
fields.format: Description, quantity/volume, and unit value for each line item. Only goods/services subject to VAT may appear on this invoice — do not mix VAT-taxable and VAT-exempt items on the same tax invoice.

fields.label: Net Value (excl. VAT)
fields.format: Stated in LKR, inclusive of cents, expressed to two decimal places.
fields.commonError: Do not round to the nearest whole rupee — several circulating secondary summaries incorrectly claim cents should be omitted. The gazette requires two decimal places.

fields.label: VAT Amount Charged
fields.format: Stated in LKR, inclusive of cents, expressed to two decimal places.

fields.label: Total Consideration (incl. VAT)
fields.format: Stated in LKR, inclusive of cents, expressed to two decimal places.
